description: Claim the NEXT pending job that matches one of `accepts` (atomic: pending → running). A job:queued announcement is a WAKE-UP, not a reservation: the claimed job may differ from the announced one, and two claims after one announcement both succeed on different jobs instead of racing for one. job:claimed carries the claimed job; job:claim-failed reports that nothing matching is pending.

accepts.description: The jobs this claim takes. A job is handed over when it matches any one of them.

_userId.description: Authenticated claimant's DID, injected by the /bus/emit gateway. Clients do not set this. The dispatcher records it as the holder on job:assigned.

_roles.description: The claimant's capabilities (the token's `roles`), injected by the /bus/emit gateway. Clients do not set this. The dispatcher authorizes the claim by capability — it admits the claim only when this carries the worker role — so a claimant that is not a worker for this knowledge base is refused before the queue is consulted.
